text:
sarah: onboarding for tenant acme-corp failing on SCIM "create". get 400 invalid displayName bytes + KMS decrypt errors. repro in staging.

mike: paste error lines?

sarah: logs:
```
2024-06-05T15:10:00Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=acme-corp POST /scim/v2/Users 400 {\"detail\":\"invalid displayName bytes\",\"status\":400}
2024-06-05T15:10:00Z kms-client WARN tenant=acme-corp decrypt: failed to unwrap key: invalid header
```

chen: "invalid header" often = key alias mismatch or wrong envelope format. any recent KMS alias rewraps?

mike: KMS audit shows a rewrap to alias/redwood-acme-v2 last week, but config still points to alias/redwood-acme. possible partial migration.

julie: okta is sending some displayName values using decomposed unicode (NFD) with combining marks. we normally normalize to NFC in userstore. if the envelope was created before rewrap in one normalization and rewrapped after a different normalization, bytes differ.

sarah: example incoming hex: f09f8c8d 20 4a6f686e CC 81 (emoji + "John" + combining acute). serializer might have changed ordering.

mike: can we repro by posting same payload to staging and capturing pre/post rewrap envelopes?

sarah: did that. pre-wrap base64: Ci0x... post-rewrap base64: Ci0y... hexdump header bytes differ (0x01 vs 0x81).

deploy-bot: [alert] scim-provisioning-failure tenant=acme-corp incident=INC-20240605-132

chen: plan:
1) pause KMS alias rollout for acme-corp
2) collect raw envelope bytes from both sides
3) add temporary NFC normalization at SCIM adapter
4) ensure RBAC mapping fallback to email/externalId (displayName is brittle)

julie: for long-term, change onboarding RBAC to prefer externalId/email, add tests for unicode normalization in SCIM harness.

mike: i'll rollback/hold the rewrap in staging and coordinate KMS ops. assigning: chen (envelope diffs), sarah (staging fix & prod rollout plan). :thumbsup:

sarah: staging patch (NFC normalize) makes provisioning succeed. will schedule short maintenance and vendor sign-off for prod deploy and follow up with PM.

julie: filing ticket to update RBAC mapping and add regression tests.

sarah: drafting postmortem after prod patch. thanks all.
